lexicalDispositions.decision: Selected four actual existing support identities with exact primary readings and applicable noun senses. All four complete families and actual articles inspected. Preserve existing word levels N2/N2/N3/N3, titles, identities and exclusions. No new article or vocabulary-level inference.

儀 has ceremony and matter/affair/case senses; the suffix is used after a name or pronoun in letters/notices. 私儀 is formal correspondence, not an ordinary new pronoun course. Keep a bounded matter/formal-suffix qualification; その儀 has search-only 其の儀. No new character reading is needed.

Instrument/model, measuring, astronomical, navigational and constellation families are not all ceremonial uses. Optional kana-supplied 地球儀 ちきゅうぎ provides a clear nonceremonial contrast; no necessary new support article. Preserve local astronomy flags and separate obsolete/rare 時辰儀 senses; 電波探信儀 is obsolete Imperial Japanese Navy radar terminology. Constellation names are not the instruments themselves. Do not infer a new character reading or general machine synonym rule.

内儀/内義: おかみ is restricted to 内儀; secret-meeting/secrecy sense restricted to ないぎ. The wife's honorific sense is separate from the familiar おかみさん family and its proprietress sense. Do not derive a new 儀 kun reading by splitting either whole-word pronunciation. Not selected for support.

Keep spelling/readings/flags separate: 奥技 is irregular usage; 別儀 べちぎ is outdated and its special-reason sense obsolete; 名儀 is search-only. 律儀 has りちぎ plus rare りつぎ, not new 儀 on readings. 辞儀 has rare spellings 辞宜/時儀, outdated じんぎ, ordinary bowing usually with お, and separate obsolete refusing. 豪儀's archaic obstinate sense is restricted to ごうぎ, while ごうき is another whole-word reading, not evidence for a new キ metadata entry. No unrestricted variant substitution.

儀仗/儀仗兵/儀仗隊 distinguish irregular 儀杖 spellings and search-only 儀じょう forms. Preserve exact weapon/ceremony/guard senses; none is necessary support or a reason to teach a search-only form as ordinary spelling.

余儀ない/余儀なく/余儀なくされる and transitive 余儀なくさせる preserve unavoidable/forced meanings and their grammatical forms. First three families mark 無 spellings search-only; the last does not. Do not generalize that flag or the passive/causative distinction. Not a grammar expansion.

Sensitive-plant family is usually kana and has re_nokanji オジギソウ; no kana-substring allocation. 威儀細 and 葬儀車 carry rare-term flags; 両儀 is obsolete. Search-only お行儀悪い/御行儀悪い, 御行儀 and 御祝儀相場 retain their own flags. お行儀 is polite manners/behavior, not inherently good conduct. Finance and organization-name flags remain local. These are not new necessary teaching identities.

Other completely inspected ceremonial, conduct, formality, role, gift, proverb and derivative families remain evidence for their exact whole-word senses, not a quota of extra support articles. Examples include 儀礼's etiquette AND religious-rite senses, 祝儀's celebration/gift/tip senses, 難儀's trouble, 大儀's ceremony AND laborious senses, and funeral establishments versus undertaker roles. Preserve exact local flags and original full families. No additional necessary support identity or source reading established; no invented frequency, historical origin or universal substitution.

comparisonDispositions.decision: Three proposed wrong-answer cards: 億 hundred million; 倍 multiple/double; 優 gentle/superior. Inspect actual displayed titles and ordinary secondary senses, not only title uniqueness. Numerical multiples, excellence and gentleness are not 儀's ordinary ceremony/formal-conduct meanings. No metadata or quiz change on these existing cards.

式 and 礼 overlap ceremony/ritual or manners and must not be wrong answers to 儀. Both existing cards already have three curated wrong choices; no default-four fallback repair needed. They are useful comparisons and counterpart backlinks, not forced semantic compartments.

Rules/regulations and manners overlap selected meaning branches: do not use as wrong meanings. 作法's etiquette sense is restricted to さほう; its production sense is separate. 規定 has additional chemistry and sports senses, not an unrestricted ceremony synonym.
機械/器械 and 装置 distinguish apparatus/instrument senses from ceremonies. Do not classify all 儀 compounds as ceremonies or all machines as 儀. No new article is needed for the nonceremonial 地球儀 contrast.

義 is a separate homophonous character with morality/meaning/doctrine and related senses. No current 義 card; keep a plain-text shape comparison rather than broken link or invented character. Occasional alternate spellings are spelling-local, not universal interchangeability.
